description: This file defines the LiteLLMHandler class, a provider handler for interfacing with the LiteLLM API, including methods for creating messages, handling model-specific behaviors, injecting thought signatures for Gemini models, and completing prompts. It manages streaming responses, cost calculation, and supports model-specific configurations.

classes.name: LiteLLMHandler
classes.description: A handler class for interfacing with LiteLLM API, supporting message creation, prompt completion, and model-specific behaviors.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the LiteLLMHandler with provided options, setting up base URL, API key, and model ID.

methods.name: isGpt5
methods.description: Checks if the given model ID corresponds to a GPT-5 model.

methods.name: isGeminiModel
methods.description: Detects if the model ID corresponds to a Gemini model requiring thought signature handling.

methods.name: injectThoughtSignatureForGemini
methods.description: Injects dummy thought signatures into tool calls for Gemini models to satisfy API validation.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Creates a streaming message response using the LiteLLM API, handling cache control, model-specific parameters, and injecting signatures for Gemini models.

methods.name: completePrompt
methods.description: Completes a prompt with the LiteLLM API, returning the generated text.
